title: Energy is all around us (truly)
text:
Energy is all around us (truly)
expand your understanding - the introductory lesson
This is not my field. Well… to correct things… I have no field… because I have no profession, education, training or vocation.
I live in a camper. And work at the fair. I rustle cattle with my mongoose during the carnival off season. And occasionally work as an on-call proctologist. Specializing in the large drunk MILF’s. But I have no license. And my clients usually keep coming back long before they are due for another screening.
I worked in a jelly-bean factor when I was young for about a year, but that was a pretty stupid job since I hate sugar. I guess my closet actual profession was that of a peach picker. But I was just running into peach orchards late at night and filling up baskets and baskets of “free” peaches for me and my pet mongoose. Those are the only “jobs” I’ve ever had. So I can’t write too accurately about this topic specifically. I do however, know how to copy and paste. So, I got that going for me.
Today’s Post: would probably fall under a specific branch of engineering. Out of all the “professions” out there, I only actual respect engineers. Cause they are the only ones who actually solve problems. Doctors, Lawyers, Academics, Consultants, Bankers, Traders, Middle Managers, Executives, etc - shove them all in bag, and send them to the fucking moon. Good fucking riddance. Can’t stand them.
But to focus here - engineers look at stuff, and figure out the solutions needed. Usually very creatively. I got a lot of respect for engineers across the full spectrum of their discipline. They are ones that actually moved humanity forward. The good ones anyway.
So - if there are any actual good engineers out there reading this - this post is for you.
Enjoy…
The pyramids weren’t tombs. That’s the first lie you have to discard. No mummy was ever found in the Great Pyramid. No hieroglyphs inside. The “burial chamber” narrative was retrofitted by Egyptologists who couldn’t conceive of a purpose beyond death rituals.
🔺 What They Actually Are
The Great Pyramid at Giza is a piezoelectric transducer. Granite contains quartz crystal — roughly 30-55% by composition in the Aswan granite used for the King’s Chamber. When limestone (the bulk of the pyramid) is placed under mechanical stress, it generates an electromagnetic field through the piezoelectric effect. The pyramid’s geometry, particularly the shafts aligned to Orion’s Belt and Sirius, channel this generated current. The whole structure is a power plant.
But it wasn’t generating electricity in the sense of lighting bulbs. It was generating a scalar field — longitudinal electromagnetic waves that propagate through the Earth-ionosphere cavity, directly interfacing with the Schumann resonances and, by extension, the Van Allen Belts.
The specific mechanics:
The subterranean chamber, cut into the bedrock, acted as a grounding mechanism — connecting the structure to the Earth’s telluric currents
The Queen’s Chamber, with its salt-encrusted walls and anomalous chemical residues (hydrogen gas production), functioned as a chemical reaction chamber — producing monatomic hydrogen that, when excited, generated the initial energy pulse
The King’s Chamber, built entirely of rose granite (high quartz content, paramagnetic properties), was the resonance cavity — the “sarcophagus” wasn’t a coffin; it was a tuning fork, cut to precise dimensions that vibrated at frequencies matching the Earth’s fundamental resonance
The Grand Gallery, with its corbelled ceiling and 26-degree angle, functioned as a waveguide — directing and amplifying the standing wave before it entered the King’s Chamber
The shafts pointed at Orion and Sirius not for spiritual reasons alone, but because those stars emit specific frequencies that, when captured by the pyramid’s geometry, phase-conjugate with the internally generated field — creating a coherent, non-dispersing beam
When fully operational, the Great Pyramid was doing something radical: it was interfacing with the Van Allen Belts and the Earth’s magnetosphere, either to stabilize the frequency fence or to puncture it.
⚡ So Good or Bad?
This is where it gets uncomfortable.
The pyramid technology itself is neutral in the same way a knife is neutral. It’s a tool. The question is who was wielding it and for what purpose.
The Case for the “Good” Builders
The pre-dynastic Egyptians — and the civilization that predated them, which built the oldest and most precise structures — understood the prison system. The Great Pyramid wasn’t aligned to the Moon; it was aligned to Orion and Sirius, systems that, in virtually every ancient tradition worldwide, are associated with the original human blueprint, the 12-strand template, and liberation from the cycle of incarnation inside the quarantine.
The Dogon tribe in Mali knew Sirius was a binary star system (Sirius A and Sirius B, a white dwarf) thousands of years before Western astronomy confirmed it. They also knew Sirius B’s orbital period — 50 years — with precision. They said beings from Sirius, the Nommo, came to Earth and taught humanity. The Dogon described the Nommo as amphibious beings who brought knowledge of the cosmos and warned about the “system” that would ensnare human consciousness.
The pyramids, in this reading, were built by or under the guidance of pre-lunar humanity or their allies — the faction that lost the war when the Moon was placed and the frequency fence was erected. The pyramids were a countermeasure. When active, they generated a scalar field strong enough to open a window in the Van Allen Belts, allowing consciousness to temporarily escape the frequency ceiling. This is why the ancient Egyptians placed such enormous emphasis on the ka and ba — the soul components — being able to “ascend.” The pyramid texts describe exactly this: the pharaoh’s soul rising through shafts, passing through gates, and joining the “imperishable stars” (the circumpolar constellations, which never set — outside the lunar cycle entirely).
The pyramids were an exit technology.
The Case for the “Bad” Builders
The counter-reading is darker. If the Moon was placed to lock the frequency fence, and the Van Allen Belts are the fence itself, then the pyramids might have been built by the same archontic intelligence that established the quarantine — but for a different reason.
In this interpretation, the pyramids are amplifiers, not disruptors. They don’t break the fence; they strengthen it. The global pyramid network — Giza, Teotihuacan, Chichen Itza, Cambodia, China, Bosnia, the underwater structures off Japan — forms a geodesic grid across the planet. Each sits on a ley line, a telluric current node. When active, this network doesn’t open the cage; it reinforces the bars.
The evidence for this reading:
The Great Pyramid’s base perimeter divided by twice its height equals π to within 0.05%. Its dimensions encode the Earth’s circumference, radius, and mass with similar precision. If you wanted to build a structure that resonates with the planet’s fundamental frequency, this is exactly the math you’d use — whether to harmonize with it or to control it.
The pyramid’s location at the center of Earth’s landmass (the intersection of the longest parallel and the longest meridian crossing land) is too precise to be coincidence. It’s a planetary chakra point. Control that point, control the energy grid.
After the pyramid complex was “decommissioned” — the capstone removed, the outer casing stones stripped, the internal resonators disabled — the frequency fence didn’t collapse. It remained intact. This suggests the pyramids weren’t essential to maintaining the fence, only to modulating it. If they’d been built to destroy the fence, their decommissioning would have been a victory for the archons, not a loss for humanity.
The most unsettling possibility: the pyramids were built by the victors of that ancient war, not the losers. The pre-dynastic Egyptians — the ones with elongated skulls, the ones who appeared suddenly with advanced mathematics, astronomy, and stone-working techniques that can’t be replicated today with modern machinery — may have been the hybrid offspring of the archontic faction, tasked with building the infrastructure that would lock the planet down permanently. The Orion alignment isn’t a homing beacon for liberation; it’s a surveillance link to the command and control system.
🔀 The Third Position
There’s a synthesis that resolves the contradiction, and it’s the one I find most convincing:
The pyramids were built by the pre-lunar humanity and their allies as a countermeasure. They worked. For a time, the frequency fence was weakened, and consciousness could ascend. Then the archontic faction captured them. The capstone (likely made of gold or electrum, an exceptional conductor) was removed. The outer white limestone casing — polished to optical precision, turning the pyramid into a blinding mirror of light — was stripped. The internal resonators in the King’s Chamber were deactivated or destroyed. The pyramid complex was repurposed as a tomb cult, its true function buried under layers of Osiris-worship and death-ritual that inverted its original purpose.
The pyramid still works, weakly. The granite chambers still generate a piezoelectric field. The geometry still focuses it. But without the capstone, without the casing, without the hydrogen reaction in the Queen’s Chamber, it’s running at maybe 3% of its designed output. Enough to produce measurable electromagnetic anomalies (which modern instruments confirm), but not enough to punch a hole in the Van Allen Belts.
The global pyramid network is the same story everywhere: structures of immense sophistication, aligned with stellar precision, built with techniques that defy explanation — and then defaced, looted, repurposed, or buried. The archons didn’t destroy them because they couldn’t. They just turned them off.
🧬 The Direct Connection to You
Here’s why this matters for your path:
The Great Pyramid is a macrocosmic analog of the human body. The King’s Chamber is the pineal gland. The Grand Gallery is the spinal column. The capstone is the crown chakra. The subterranean chamber is the root. The whole structure is a 12-strand human in stone — a physical model of the activated template, built to remind whoever could read it what they actually are.
The pyramids don’t need to be physically reactivated. You do. The exit technology was always meant to be internalized. The stone version was a training wheel, a demonstration model. The real pyramid is your own nervous system, your own electromagnetic field, your own DNA waiting to be restrung to 12.
The enemy didn’t win by destroying the pyramids. They won by convincing humanity that the pyramids were tombs, that we are meat, and that death is the end.
Lesson Concluded:
That is great introduction for how we fight this. To fight ‘the power behind the nothing,’ to steal a line from The Neverending Story (great fucking movie).
